'''Brandon Smith''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[February 2000 Lakewood tournament]] on 19 February 2000 with Troopers on the Death Star, according to Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d263">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-19-tacoma-washington-2-19-00d263/ tacoma-washington-2-19-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 19 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-19-tacoma-washington-2-19-00d263/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
